title: Fortune Is Unpredictable and Mutable
subtitle: Driven out from his orphanage, Nakajima Atsushi wanders the streets of Yokohama on the bring of starvation. Determined to live, a chance encounter with a drowning stranger changes his fate.

title: A Certain Bomb
subtitle: Despite joining the Armed Detective Agency, Nakajima lacks conviction that he'd be of any use. Just as he's about to bid the agency farewell, a bomber takes over the agency with one of the agency employees as his hostage.

title: Yokohama Gangster Paradise
subtitle: Now an official member of the Agency after passing their entrance exam, Atsushi is assigned to his first case right away with Tanizaki and Naomi. Though deceptively simple on the surface, there's more than meets the eye.

title: The Tragedy of the Fatalist
subtitle: Though saved from the Port Mafia by Dazai's intervention, Atsushi feels responsible for bringing trouble to the Agency's door. Rather than risk another attack because of him, Atsushi decides to leave the Agency.

title: Murder on D Street
subtitle: After repelling the Port Mafia's Black Lizards with deceptive ease, Atsushi is tasked with assisting Rampo on a case. Skeptical of the self-dubbed great detective who seems to lack all common sense, Atsushi is about to witness Rampo's ability first-hand.

title: The Azure Messenger
subtitle: The Agency investigates a series of disappearances in Yokohama. Kunikida enlists the help of a hacker named Taguchi Rokuzou, but all they find are photos of the victims and mentions of a mysterious figure called the Azure Messenger.

title: Love for the Disease Called Ideals
subtitle: Following the Azure Messenger's bomb threat, the Armed Detective Agency must race to prevent the deaths of hundreds. However, Dazai's seemingly distracted by Sasaki Nobuko, the lone survivor of their raid on the abandoned hospital.

title: Teaching Them to Kill, Then to Die
subtitle: Dazai goes missing, but the Agency operatives feel it's just business as usual. Meanwhile, Atsushi accompanies Yosano Akiko on a shopping expedition, where they are suddenly plunged into the middle of a terrorist bomb threat!

title: The Beauty Is Quiet Like a Stone Statue
subtitle: Kyouka was made into an assassin by those who abused her ability, and Atsushi can't help but feel sympathy toward her. Unable to turn her in to the military police, Atsushi ends up taking her out on a date. Meanwhile, Akutagawa is busy berating his former supervisor--Dazai

title: Rashomon and the Tiger
subtitle: Dazai has a face-off with his ex-partner, Chuuya, as Chuuya attempts to discover why Dazai let himself get captured. Meanwhile, Atsuhi faces Akutagawa's intense and inexplicable hatred for him.

title: First, an Unsuitable Profession for Her. Second, an Ecstatic Detective Agency.
subtitle: In the aftermath of Atsushi and Dazai's abduction, the Agency must decide what to do with Kyouka. Meanwhile, the Port Mafia also deliberates what to do with Akutagawa, now comatose, as his enemies seek vengeance.

title: Borne Back Ceaselessly Into the Past
subtitle: The Agency encounters The Guild. A fight between members ensues. Port Mafia's boss is revealed.

title: The Dark Age
subtitle: On a misty night, Oda Sakunosuke, Dazai Osamu, and Sakaguchi Ango meet as always at their usual bar. For the trio of Port Mafia members, it a night spent in camaraderie like any other, but Ango vanishes that very night. Oda is given a direct order from the Port Mafia boss to find Ango, but.

title: Nowhere to Return
subtitle: Odasaku went to a certain Western style restaurant was not only for their curry: the owner watches over a group of children who lost their parents in the war. Meanwhile, Dazai manages to catch one of the Mimic soldiers alive in a trap he had set.

title: A Room Where We Can Someday See the Ocean
subtitle: The Port Mafia's council of five top executives has decreed that Mimic must be annihilated. In the ensuing battle, Odasaku has a fateful encounter with the leader of Mimic, who makes a cryptic prophecy.

title: Bungo Stray Dogs
subtitle: While the leaders of the Port Mafia and the gifted special operations division meet via Ango, Dazai is close to discovering the true significance of the conflict between the three groups.

title: Three Companies Conflict
subtitle: Kyouka works her first job at the Armed Detective Agency but the job ends in a minor disaster. As Atsushi attempts to cheer her up, the unthinkable happens--Kyouka's inactive cell phone rings, and a voice orders Demon Snow to attack Atsushi.

title: The Strategy of Conflict
subtitle: Mori, the leader of the Port Mafia, sends a letter to Margaret M. and Nathaniel H., threatening to destroy them and the ship they are protecting.

title: Will of Tycoon
subtitle: John S. and Lovecraft hunt down Naomi and Haruno as they flee from town. While Atsushi and Dazai wait for them to arrive at the train station, Dazai notices a shady figure stalking him.

title: Though the Mind May be Wrong
subtitle: Atsushi is abducted onto the Moby Dick. Meanwhile, Lovecraft succeeds in capturing Q. Francis F. and the Guild prepare to carry out their emergency plan.

title: Double Black
subtitle: The leaders of the Agency and the Port Mafia negotiate an alliance. Meanwhile, Dazai and Chuuya face off against Lovecraft.

title: Poe and Rampo - Moby Dick, Swimming in the Sky
subtitle: Rampo receives an invitation to a detective game from none other than E. A. Poe. He's indifferent at first, until Poe reveals what the reward would be should he win.

title: Rashoumon, the Tiger and the Last Emperor
subtitle: Atsushi searches desperately for the control terminal, which he would need to stop the Moby Dick from crashing into Yokohama. He's greeted by Akutagawa and Francis, both of whom have other plans in mind.

title: If I May Shed Away My Burden Now
subtitle: Atsushi and Akutagawa fail to call off the Moby Dick's descent. They search desperately for other ways to protect Yokohama.

title: OVA: He Walks Alone
subtitle: Doppo Kunikida intervenes in a plot to blow up a train, but ends up running into an old acquaintance in the process. Will anything end up going as planned for him?

title: Dazai, Chuuya, Fifteen Years Old
subtitle: Port Mafia leader Mori Ougai orders a fifteen-year-old Dazai Osamu to investigate the appearance of a certain individual in the Yokohama Settlement area.

title: God of Fire
subtitle: Dazai Osamu and Nakahara Chuuya are attacked by GSS soldiers in the middle of investigating an explosion caused years ago by Arahabaki.

title: A Diamond is Only a Diamond
subtitle: Nakahara Chuuya and Dazai Osamu reveal the truth behind Arahabaki, Randou, the former Port Mafia boss and Chuuya himself.

title: My Ill Deeds Are the Work of God
subtitle: Fyodor Dostoevsky finally steps out of the shadows as Ace, a Port Mafia executive, tries to lure Fyodor into joining his army of slaves.

title: Slap the Stick and Addict
subtitle: The Armed Detective Agency gets over with their burn-out syndrome while former agency member Katai makes his debut.

title: Herurisu/Portrait of a Father
subtitle: Atshushi and Kyouka get their parent problems sorted out.

title: Fitzgerald Rising
subtitle: Fitzgerald rises while he tries and succeeds in obtaining The Eyes of God.

title: The Masked Assassin
subtitle: Fyodor Dostoevsky makes his move on the Armed Detective Agency and the Port Mafia as he plants the Cannibalism poison into both of the group's leaders.

title: Cannibalism (Part One)
subtitle: The Cannibalism arc begins as the two ability groups are forced into a decision if they should kill the other group's leader first.

title: Cannibalism (Part Two)
subtitle: The Detective Agency president is in safe hands for now, but unless he or the Port Mafia boss dies, a full-scale war between the two organizations is inevitable.

title: Cannibalism (Part 3)
subtitle: Mori Ougai and Fukuzawa Yukichi fight to the death in a desperate bid to save the organizations they lead from falling into a devastating war.

title: Echo
subtitle: Cannibalism finally comes to an end with the Armed Detective Agency and the Port Mafia joining forces to defeat the true virus ability user.

title: The Lone Swordsman and the Famous Detective
subtitle: 32 year-old Yukichi Fukuzawa, hoping to leave behind his past as an assassin, comes across 14 year-old Ranpo Edogawa at the scene of a murder. Realizing Ranpo's unparalleled genius, he takes the boy under his wing.

title: The Day Is a Dream, the Night Is Real
subtitle: Fukuzawa gives Rampo a pair of glasses, claiming that wearing them would activate his ability to instantly determine the truth of any situation, and taking them off would give him the ability to tolerate the stupidity of ordinary people.

title: The Secret Founding of the Detective Agency
subtitle: Rampo gets a ride to the police station, but the officer doesn't seem to be who he says he is.

title: A Perfect Murder and Murderer: Part 1
subtitle: Kunikida is being held for a murder that Rampo is certain he didn't commit. Meanwhile, Poe is determined to solve a murder mystery that has had the police stumped. Rampo has some thoughts on that situation, too.

title: A Perfect Murder and Murderer: Part 2
subtitle: The last page of the manuscript received by Poe appears to have been a photocopy. Rampo seems to know why, but there are still more mysteries surrounding the death of the author.

title: Tragic Sunday
subtitle: The Detective Agency receives an urgent request from the government to investigate a series murders perpetrated by the same culprit.

title: Dogs Hunt Dogs
subtitle: The Detective Agency is framed for the brutal murder of several government officials. Its members are on the run from the Military Police.

title: We Are Both Sinners
subtitle: The Armed Detective Agency is rescued by the Port Mafia, while Atsushi and Kyouka seek out the help of Francis Fitzgerald. Dazai meets the mastermind behind the plan to doom the agency.

title: A Dream of Butterflies
subtitle: Port Mafia boss Mori wants Yosano to join them in exchange for assisting the Detective Agency through their crisis. Yosano reveals why she would rather not.

title: In Lament of My Wingless Body
subtitle: Tanizaki, Miyazawa and Yosano head to the site where Yosano is scheduled to be handed off to the Port Mafia.

title: Jalibreak
subtitle: Atsushi and Kyouka convince Mushitaro to escape the vault with them. While making their escape the bank is surrounded by the Special Operations Division being led by Sakaguchi Ango, a member of the Seventh Agency.

title: Bungo Hound Dogs
subtitle: Suspecting that Lucy is cooperating with the terrorist organization known as the Armed Detective Agency, Jouno and Tetchou pay a visit to the cafe at where she works, in hopes of tracking down Atsushi and Kyouka.

title: Skyfall
subtitle: Dazai instructs Atsushi to capture Sigma, who holds the key to stopping the Decay of the Angels' planned terrorist attack. Sigma, meanwhile, is hell-bent on protecting the Sky Casino.

title: The Strongest Man
subtitle: In the aftermath of the Sky Casino's fall, Kunikida's faced with a terrible choice. Ango, Atsushi, Lucy, and Kyoka dig deeper into the secrets hidden within Atsushi's memories, and Rampo proves his worth as the world's greatest detective.

title: The Answer to Everything
subtitle: Kamui, the head of Decay of the Angel, has the page. Fukuzawa orders the detectives to destroy it. Ranpo, despite being a wanted person, proudly appears at the press conference, exposing the truth and involving the police.

title: Hero vs. Criminal
subtitle: Kamui's identity's revealed. Facing a formidable enemy, Atsushi fights without a single ally until Akutagawa comes to help. The two devise an attack plan to defeat Kamui using a combination of their special abilities...will it work?

title: HERO WAR, GANG WAR
subtitle: The last member of Decay of the Angels is revealed. Kamui continues to spread chaos. Tachihara entrusts Fukuchi with the information device containing evidence obtained at the Sky Casino, only to face devastating consequences.

title: At the Port in the Sky - Part 1
subtitle: A supernatural weapon of mental domination, One Order, is to be delivered to Fukuchi. Members of the detective agency head to the airport to stop him.

title: At the Port in the Sky - Part 2
subtitle: Fukuchi's plans and the Agency's attempts to thwart him escalate, and Aya comes face to face with Count Bram. Meanwhile, Nikolai and Sigma move to rescue Dazai and Fyodor from prison, but Nikolai has more than rescue on his mind.

title: At the Port in the Sky - Part 3
subtitle: As Atsushi races to find Teruko, Kenji arrives to help Aya and Bram escape the airport.

title: Land of Inhuman Demons - Part 1
subtitle: Kenji fights to help Atsushi, demonstrating why he is one of the most dangerous Agency members. Meanwhile, Dazai's machinations within the prison become clearer.

title: Land of Inhuman Demons - Part 2
subtitle: Fukuzawa and Fukuchi confront their shared past as time runs out for the Detective Agency.

title: Land of Inhuman Demons - Part 3
subtitle: Dazai and Sigma are trapped in a flooding room. Atsushi is attacked by Akutagawa when he attempts to help Aya. During their fight Aya desperately tries to remove the holy sword from Bram.

title: Twilight Goodbye
subtitle: The final pieces of Fukuchi's plot snap into place, trapping Fukuzawa in a way not even Rampo could anticipate. At the same time, Fyodor and Dazai's deadly game draws to a close.
